lead: Captured aviation software signals reveal active procurement and platform deployments across EFB, flight planning, and digital operations suites, led by supplier activity from Jeppesen, Lufthansa Systems, Navblue, and IFS. Low-cost carrier adoption highlights vendor-specific wins, such as IFS securing MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet.

insights.title: IFS secures multiple low-cost carrier EFB adoptions
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFB footprint among low-cost carriers by deploying IFS EFBOne to MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and being selected by fastjet for its Embraer 145 fleet.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is an LCC operating cargo services.
insights.caveat: Captures represent publicly announced wins and do not account for unannounced churn or evaluations.

insights.title: Jeppesen expands ForeFlight and dispatch capabilities
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced ForeFlight Airflow integrating AI into flight operations and released FliteDeck Pro v5.3 with Enroute Profile View.
insights.aviation_context: Commercial flight crews utilize enroute profile views and automated planning tools for situational awareness.
insights.caveat: Product announcements reflect marketing and release milestones rather than full fleet deployment status.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems evaluates strategic sale of business units
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems reportedly explored the sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine provide core flight planning, navigation, and crew management software to global airlines.
insights.caveat: Media reports of M&A explorations do finalised corporate transactions.

insights.title: Aviobook signs long-term EFB agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) platforms replace paper charts and manuals in the cockpit.
insights.caveat: Agreement terms are based on captured vendor announcements.

insights.title: Navblue expands TransNusa collaboration
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue by signing for Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+.
insights.aviation_context: Integrated flight and technical operations platforms combine maintenance and operational data.
insights.caveat: Deployment timelines following agreement signings are not fully detailed in all sources.
